name: localeditor
description: Read and edit local documents, create Mermaid diagrams, draw editable Canvas wireframes and sketches, and compose Pages in approved LocalEditor Projects and Scratchpads.

interface.longDescription: Create structured Mermaid diagrams in Markdown, draw editable Canvas wireframes and spatial artwork, and compose Pages with images and linked subpages in LocalEditor on macOS. Explicit format choices and existing files are preserved. Work in Projects and Scratchpads approved through Agent Access; files stay local.
defaultPrompt: Show me the Projects available through LocalEditor Agent Access.
Create a LocalEditor Scratchpad for these notes.
Help me revise a document in my LocalEditor Project.
